CustomField.description: Set once a guest has been reminded, so one reminder stays one reminder. GxFeedbackDispatch sets it in the same committed update as the token, before the reminder email leaves - which means a reminder whose email fails is not retried. That is deliberate: with a guest's inbox at stake, under-reminding is the safer failure.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Whether this guest has already had a feedback reminder. Set automatically.
CustomField.label: Survey Reminder Sent
